title: Q11
description:
Read: Psa 45:6-7, Exo 7:1, Psa 82:1-7

A king is addressed as God and still has a God who anoints him. A man is made god to a king for a task. Judges are called gods and told they will die like men.

a) Which of these three ways of saying "god" can carry the address to the Son, and which break if they are used of Him?
